correction_history: v4 held because entablature appeared about0.18 column height versus roughly0.34 in frontal photograph. v5 raises horizontal band to17mm/56.5mm=0.30 without shortening columns; all five new previews inspected and correction accepted. Ratios are rough photo estimates, not measurements.
scope: Approval of coarse historical exterior identity, column/roof topology, proportions and disclosed simplifications only; not a survey, structural calculation, detailed ornament reconstruction or manufacture certification.
limitations: Rear partly obscured by trees in references; fine rear ornaments not verified.
Blank pediment omits real shield and scroll relief. Coarse frieze segmentation and fluting are simplified, not exact ornament counts.
Flat green roof panels simplify actual glazed tiles; no tile count or precise top surface survey claimed.
Dimensions, column taper, memorial details and colors are approximate; night illumination is not treated as intrinsic material color.
Obelisk, pool, garden, outer access stairs and hidden contents excluded.

Reported two global thin layers and one local eave sample warning remain relevant; visual PASS does not clear them. Flat ceiling, eaves and spans require slicing/support assessment; no actual print test.
